target_customer: Robotics and IoT companies running fleets of devices
problem: Teams scaling robot fleets struggle to deploy software and manage configuration across devices. Miru provides config management, deployment and access control for robots.
business_model: B2B SaaS for robotics fleet configuration
product_category: Robotics deployment and config management infrastructure

founders.name: Armel Talla
education: UT Austin, BS Computer Science and Mathematics

founders.name: Vedant Nair
education: UT Austin, Business and Computer Science

founders.name: Benjamin Smidt
education: UT Austin, BS Electrical and Computer Engineering

technical_complexity.rationale: Over the air updates, device provisioning and versioned configuration across heterogeneous robots is standard infrastructure engineering with hardware heterogeneity as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Once embedded in fleet deployment, switching is painful, but a three person team's tooling can be rebuilt in house or by larger fleet platforms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Fleet and device platforms exist, but no dated evidence of copying or acquisition of Miru found.

market_need_then: Robotics deployments were growing and teams built config tooling in house. Evidence is positioning on the YC launch post, which drew about 235 upvotes per an aggregator.

branding.domain_note: Uses mirurobotics.com on the YC page and miruml.com in aggregators.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Not verified, site text was unavailable

brand_strength.rationale: Short name but no press about the brand or community found; search results mix with other 'Miru' and 'Mirokai' robotics names.

pivots.from: Deployment infrastructure for robotics and IoT
pivots.why: Aggregator and YC listing wording changed over time; reason not stated

outcome_analysis: Miru is an active three founder team from UT Austin that previously built Clips AI and now sells robot fleet config tooling. It has shipped features such as access control per its CEO's LinkedIn activity, but funding is only reported by aggregators, so the outcome stage is early and unproven.
notes: Unverified aggregator data: $500K pre-seed or seed in September 2024 (VCBacked, CB Insights, Standout; investors listed as YC, Pioneer Fund, Orange Collective, General Catalyst differ by source) and a $2.7M pre-seed on 2025-09-12 led by Cadenza Ventures and Dreamcraft Ventures (StartupIntros only). Company website returned only a title so no site detail. Competitors Formant, Foxglove, Rocos, Balena appear only in undated comparison pages, so the dated list is empty. The pre-seed round rests on a single database (VCBacked); stage varies by source (seed vs pre-seed). The 2.7M USD round of September 2025 (Cadenza, Dreamcraft) belongs to Miru Labs, a different cybersecurity company (Seedcamp announcement), so it is not recorded.
